rules.why: The divider is <hr>, or <li role="separator"> inside a list.
An announced <li> divider without role="separator" is read as an empty item.
A focusable separator is a Window Splitter, another component.
A vertical divider that is announced says so; the separator is horizontal by default.
Decorative is aria-hidden="true"; announced has no attribute.

manual.why: A divider never opens or closes its container and never sits next to another one.
<hr> never goes directly inside <ul>/<ol> - invalid HTML; use <li role="separator">.
